what_it_does: Leopard solves a bottleneck at the edge: when small computers at branch offices or factories need to access data stored in cloud data centers far away. Currently, the CPU handles the request forwarding one-at-a-time, leaving the fast storage connection (NVMe) underutilized and degrading performance by 75%. Leopard implements a smart NVMe controller on an FPGA chip inside the network card that directly handles multiple concurrent storage requests in parallel, completely bypassing the CPU. This lets the edge device saturate the fast link without CPU intervention.
